applets.name: Claws of the Crown: The Great Duck's Elixir
applets.description: A 16-bit pixel-art 2D top-down story action-RPG where Pip the tabby cat knight quests for the Great Duck's Elixir to reclaim the Cat Kingdom from Usurper King Fenrir.

applets.name: BlockCraft Alchemy
applets.description: A chunky 3D-blocky infinite alchemy game powered by Gemini Structured Outputs with procedural 8-bit Web Audio and voxel particle physics.

applets.name: Neko Noir: Rooftop Paws
applets.description: Playable 16-bit cyber-noir pixel cat rooftop parkour game with an 8-bit Web Audio synthesizer, procedural cat breed matrices, and AI Studio Super-Prompt Builder.

applets.name: Huyền Thoại Bông Văn Dĩa - Đường Hồ Chí Minh Trên Biển
applets.description: Game góc nhìn thứ nhất (First-person) tái hiện chân thực chiến tích lịch sử của Anh hùng LLVTND Bông Văn Dĩa trên hải trình tàu không số khai mở Đường Hồ Chí Minh trên biển.

applets.name: Wild Guardians: Sanctuary Defense
applets.description: A premium glassmorphic tower defense game featuring collectible animal guardians, high-tech enemies, and stunning procedural biome visuals.

applets.name: Primal Defense: Animal Kingdom
applets.description: A high-stakes Tower Defense game where animals defend their territory against high-tech hunters. Features gacha summoning, rarity systems, and spinning units.
